_comment: This file is a Boost.Build test script (alternatives.py). It contains no callable functions, classes, or APIs. It is a linear test harness script that uses BoostBuild.Tester to verify Boost.Build's target alternatives selection logic. No argparse-compatible entry points exist.
test_boost_build_alternatives: run the Boost.Build test script that verifies target alternatives selection for build variants
test_alternative_selection_user_defined_: run the test that verifies alternative selection works with user-defined propagated features
test_alternative_selection_default_build: run the test that verifies alternative selection works correctly with the default debug build
test_alternative_ambiguity_detection: run the test that verifies ambiguity is reported when no best alternative can be determined
test_alternative_subfeature_expansion: run the test that verifies subfeatures are expanded in alternatives and unknown subfeatures fail to match
